issue.title: Abort a gated typed-admission launch bundle so ,X can stop un-admitted %if/%proc units
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead sase-w8.3 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #1) while implementing the in-flight deferred kill for epic sase-w8, and filed by that epic's land agent.

`,X` on an in-flight launch records kill intent and, at launch-proc completion, kills every returned `AgentLaunchResult`. When the completion payload carries `admission_complete: false` (a `%if`/`%proc` typed-admission bundle whose coordinator outlives the launch proc), the remaining gated units are still being launched by the detached coordinator; ACE can only warn about them. See `_execute_deferred_kill_for_results` / `apply_deferred_launch_kill_on_completion` in `src/sase/ace/tui/actions/agent_workflow/_kill_last_launch.py` and the `admission_complete` plumbing in `src/sase/ace/tui/actions/agent_workflow/_launch_procs.py`.

Wanted: a sase-core abort-bundle operation plus the binding and ACE wiring that lets the deferred kill cancel un-admitted units instead of warning about them.

task_type_fields.proposal:
Add a sase-core operation that aborts an in-flight gated typed-admission launch bundle: given a bundle/admission-coordinator handle, cancel the units that have not been admitted yet and tear the coordinator down, so callers can stop a launch gesture as a unit instead of only killing the agents whose `AgentLaunchResult`s already came back.

Concrete consumer: ACE's `,X` (kill & edit last launched agent, epic sase-w8). When a `%if`/`%proc` prompt goes through typed admission, the launch proc can exit with `admission_complete: false` while a detached coordinator keeps launching the remaining units. `apply_deferred_launch_kill_on_completion` in `src/sase/ace/tui/actions/agent_workflow/_kill_last_launch.py` therefore kills only the returned results and toasts that gated units continue in the background - the undo is incomplete for exactly the prompts that fan out the most.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: This is core-backend surface, not TUI presentation: the admission coordinator is durable sase-core state (built by epic sase-s6, phase sase-s6.3), and any frontend - ACE, CLI, a future web UI - would need the same abort semantics. Per the rust_core_backend_boundary rule it must not be reimplemented in this repo, so epic sase-w8's plan explicitly scoped it out of v1 and told phase sase-w8.3 to record it as a proposed follow-up instead. Nothing is currently broken: sase-s6 delivered admission as designed and `,X` behaves as documented within its stated v1 limit.

payload.description: sase-s6 phase 3 built the durable launch admission coordinator whose detached lifetime creates the un-abortable gated-unit window this task closes
